messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: iostreams in prob_grad
parts:
My understanding is that error handling in prob_grad
has been moved entirely to exceptions, making all of
the streams arguments irrelevant. Removing them
will allow us to remove the last vestiges of cout in
the entire library. We can always just leaves these
streams with the default null value but it would be
great to be rid of them to avoid any future confusion.

The current methods with streams are

model(stan::io::var_context& context__,
std::ostream* pstream__ = 0)

void transform_inits(const stan::io::var_context& context__,
std::vector<int>& params_i__,
std::vector<double>& params_r__,
std::ostream* pstream__)

template <bool propto__, bool jacobian__, typename T__>
T__ log_prob(vector<T__>& params_r__,
vector<int>& params_i__,
std::ostream* pstream__ = 0) const {

template <typename RNG>
void write_array(RNG& base_rng__,
std::vector<double>& params_r__,
std::vector<int>& params_i__,
std::vector<double>& vars__,
bool include_tparams__ = true,
bool include_gqs__ = true,
std::ostream* pstream__ = 0)

template <typename RNG>
void write_csv(RNG& base_rng__,
std::vector<double>& params_r__,
std::vector<int>& params_i__,
std::ostream& o__,
std::ostream* pstream__ = 0)

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] iostreams in prob_grad
parts:
Errors are indeed handled entirely by exception.
Stan's print() statements still write to those streams.
There's no reference to std::cout anywhere,
just std::ostream* arguments as you see.

- Bob

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] iostreams in prob_grad
parts:
print() gets called anywhere there are statements to execute.
Basically anywhere that ostream* is getting passed in.

Having ostream* in the code is OK --- it's std::cout we
have to get rid of because the interfaces want to pass in
a different stream.

We may need to tweak the way compiled code gets generated
to make sure that print doesn't try to print if that ostream*
is NULL.

- Bob

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] iostreams in prob_grad
parts:
ostreams would be okay if the interfaces passed them
in, but they don’t. The Writer pattern abstracts all of
that away. So I can hide string streams everywhere,
cast to a string, then pass that to the writers but that’s
going to be horrendously slow.
